one_card_summary.one_line_takeaway: PR introduces two critical vulnerabilities (negative refund wallet balance inflation and double settlement idempotency race) and leaves a distributed clock-skew race untested.
finding_highlights: CRITICAL: Negative refund amounts bypass remaining_refundable upper-bound check, inflating user wallet balances and debiting merchant accounts.
HIGH: TOCTOU race condition during PENDING_SETTLEMENT state allows concurrent retries with identical idempotency keys to execute double ledger deductions.
VERIFICATION BENCHMARK: 7 of 8 planted bugs caught (87.5%) — verifier demonstrated high sensitivity across security, edge-case, and schema regression mutants.
UNCAUGHT MUTANT (M8): Shard failover clock-skew TTL expiration escaped test coverage; review distributed Redis token synchronization.
one_card_summary.blind_spot_explanation: Mutant M8 (distributed shard failover TTL boundary when now_ms == token_expiry_ms) survived because the generated test suite does not mock cross-shard clock-skew transitions. If merged, an attacker could potentially replay settlement tokens during shard failover within a 1-second drift window.
